title: 俄亥俄州长选战广告风波
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Mark, we know that this ad and the blowback has gotten a lot of national attention, but how is it actually influencing the climate in Ohio?
segments.zh: 马克，我们知道这则广告和引发的反弹已经引起全国关注，但它实际上如何影响俄亥俄州的政治气候？

segments.en: Well, that's going to be the big question is whether this moves any votes. There was a sense that Amy Acton had a lead in Ohio,
segments.zh: 嗯，关键问题是这是否会改变选票。此前有一种感觉是，艾米·阿克顿在俄亥俄州州长竞选中领先，

segments.en: the Ohio governor's race, but that, you know, the Republicans would come home at the end and would pull it out. That was a general sense. But this ad coming less than two weeks before voting,
segments.zh: 但你知道，共和党人最终会回归并胜出。这是一种普遍看法。但这则广告在投票前不到两周出现，

segments.en: I think raises a question of whether any of these votes that were moved, these folks who were on the fence or not even planning to vote in the Ohio governor's race,
segments.zh: 我认为这引发了一个问题：这些被改变的选票中，那些犹豫不决或甚至不打算在俄亥俄州州长竞选中投票的人，

segments.en: you know, might get involved now. Acton's brother, Philip Sterns, condemned the ad as despicable.
segments.zh: 你知道，现在可能会参与进来。阿克顿的兄弟菲利普·斯特恩斯谴责这则广告是可鄙的。

segments.en: The fact that the campaign is doubling down here with a $4 million ad buy means people are
segments.zh: 竞选团队加倍投入400万美元购买广告，这意味着人们

segments.en: going to be seeing this ad a lot. Mark, if he loses the race, will it be because of this choice?
segments.zh: 会经常看到这则广告。马克，如果他输掉竞选，会是因为这个选择吗？

segments.en: It's hard to say if it will be because of this choice. But the context here is this ad comes after months of negative ads that the Ramaswamy campaign and his allies have run depicting
segments.zh: 很难说是否会因为这个选择。但背景是，这则广告之前，拉马斯瓦米竞选团队及其盟友已经进行了数月的负面广告，描绘

segments.en: Amy Acton as a drunk and incompetent questioning or medical qualifications. So it's been a very negative campaign. So this comes on top of that. And there is some thought that, you know, this might
segments.zh: 艾米·阿克顿是醉鬼和无能之辈，质疑其医疗资格。所以这是一场非常负面的竞选。这则广告是在此基础上出现的。有人认为，这可能
